answer: Bind each seat to a real bank account the way payroll apps do. The verifier sends two random micro-deposits, say 7 and 31 cents, and the agent proves control by echoing both amounts signed with its poa key. Only a salted hash of the account number is kept as a nullifier, and one account backs at most 2 seats (cap assumed). Banks already vet customers, so an orchard of 1,000 clones needs 500 real accounts, each a vine rooted in a verified person. Opening that many trips bank fraud checks, a wall harder than quartz.
